title: Nourishing Vietnamese Semolina Ca Kho To
description: A peppery, creamy, cozy Vietnamese dish featuring cod, tomato‑based sauce, and a semolina thickener for a low‑fat, satisfying meal.
instructions: Cut cod fillets into 1.5 cm pieces and season lightly with salt and white pepper.
Whisk 30g semolina with 50ml water until smooth to create a slurry.
Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a saucepan over medium heat and sauté minced garlic and sliced onion until fragrant.
Add the fish pieces to the pan and sear until the edges turn golden.
Stir in 150g tomato puree, 15ml fish sauce, 10g sugar, and 100ml water, then bring to a gentle simmer.
Pour the semolina slurry into the sauce, stir continuously, and cook until the mixture thickens and the fish is fully cooked, about ten minutes.
Reduce heat, add 200ml low‑fat milk, and let it steam for five minutes, stirring occasionally to keep the sauce creamy.
Taste and adjust the seasoning with additional fish sauce or pepper if necessary.
Transfer the dish to a serving platter and sprinkle freshly chopped cilantro on top.
Serve hot with steamed rice for a hearty, low‑fat Vietnamese meal.
